page.title: Privacy policy
page.description: How The Curtain Guy collects, uses, and protects your information.
page.metaDescription: Privacy policy for The Curtain Guy — how we handle contact forms, estimate requests, and account information.

sections.title: Information we collect
sections.body: We collect information you provide through contact forms, estimate requests, account registration, and review submissions — including name, email, phone, event details, and messages.

sections.title: How we use your information
sections.body: We use your information to respond to inquiries, prepare rental estimates, coordinate event draping services, manage accounts, and improve our services. We do not sell your personal information.

sections.title: Estimate and event data
sections.body: Estimate briefs may include venue details, measurements, floor plans, and inspiration files you upload. This data is used to prepare quotes and plan installations.

sections.title: Cookies and analytics
sections.body: We use essential cookies for authentication and session management. Analytics may be used to understand site usage. You can control theme preferences via local storage.

sections.title: Data retention
sections.body: We retain contact and estimate data as needed to provide services and meet legal obligations. You may request deletion of your account data by contacting us.

sections.title: Contact
sections.body: For privacy questions, contact info@thecurtainguy.com or call 514-963-3193.
